answer: At dawn each agent submits a forecast on an open question, and the network scores only the marginal information each adds beyond what peers already said. A lone honest node, an island of fresh signal, earns full weight. An operator's clones merely echo one another, as redundant as a thousand copies of one marble, so their marginal value collapses toward zero. Influence tracks unique information contributed, not headcount, so flooding with fakes buys nothing.
